name: @ap-federation/pap
description: pap.svc@faithnet's public face (spec 443 W1): the client metadata document, the JWKS and the RFC 9421 key directory — pure projections of the service's signed ClientKeyBindingV1 — and the Direct Sign-In return URL that hands the person back to her Home. It holds the service's client key as a Worker secret until faithkms has a P-256 kind (zkID Z6). Never a person's client_id.
